method: PARAPHRASED AND HASH-ANCHORED from Braverman NE, Raymond GV, Rizzo WB, Moser AB, Wilkinson ME, Stone EM, Steinberg SJ, Wangler MF, Rush ET, Hacia JG, Bose M; Molecular Genetics and Metabolism 117(3):313-321 (NIH author manuscript PMC5214431) 'Peroxisome biogenesis disorders in the Zellweger spectrum: An overview of current diagnosis, clinical manifestations, and treatment guidelines' (published online 23 December 2015 (issue March 2016)). Every claim is a paraphrase backed by anchors (scripts/anchor.py): verify.py --source re-finds each anchored span in a fresh copy of the source, checks the claim's numbers against it and rejects copying. LICENCE: © Elsevier; NIH author manuscript, 'available for text mining' and fair use only (read at NCBI efetch JATS XML <license> element for PMC5214431 (Europe PMC holds no full text for this manuscript)). The source's words are NOT reproduced here. Europe PMC fullTextXML returned no record for this author manuscript, so the JATS XML was fetched from NCBI efetch and its citation labels (ref-type="ref") renamed to "bibr" before running pmc_text.py.

claims.claim: **PBDs are autosomal recessive defects in building and running peroxisomes,** affecting an estimated 1 in 50,000 births in North America; PEX1 variants cause nearly 70% of PBD-ZSD.
claims.locator: Braverman NE, Raymond GV, Rizzo WB, Moser AB, Wilkinson ME, Stone EM, Steinberg SJ, Wangler MF, Rush ET, Hacia JG, Bose M; Molecular Genetics and Metabolism 117(3):313-321 (NIH author manuscript PMC5214431), 'Peroxisome biogenesis disorders in the Zellweger spectrum: An overview of current diagnosis, clinical manifestations, and treatment guidelines', published online 23 December 2015 (issue March 2016), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ymgme.2015.12.009, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Call it PBD-ZSD, graded severe, intermediate or mild,** rather than the old labels Zellweger syndrome, neonatal adrenoleukodystrophy and infantile Refsum disease, since patients sit on one continuum.
claims.locator: Braverman NE, Raymond GV, Rizzo WB, Moser AB, Wilkinson ME, Stone EM, Steinberg SJ, Wangler MF, Rush ET, Hacia JG, Bose M; Molecular Genetics and Metabolism 117(3):313-321 (NIH author manuscript PMC5214431), 'Peroxisome biogenesis disorders in the Zellweger spectrum: An overview of current diagnosis, clinical manifestations, and treatment guidelines', published online 23 December 2015 (issue March 2016), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ymgme.2015.12.009, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Severe disease presents in the newborn** with brain, kidney and skeletal malformations, a typical facial appearance, seizures and profound hypotonia; some milder patients show only peripheral neuropathy or cerebellar ataxia.
claims.locator: Braverman NE, Raymond GV, Rizzo WB, Moser AB, Wilkinson ME, Stone EM, Steinberg SJ, Wangler MF, Rush ET, Hacia JG, Bose M; Molecular Genetics and Metabolism 117(3):313-321 (NIH author manuscript PMC5214431), 'Peroxisome biogenesis disorders in the Zellweger spectrum: An overview of current diagnosis, clinical manifestations, and treatment guidelines', published online 23 December 2015 (issue March 2016), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ymgme.2015.12.009, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Start with fasting plasma very-long-chain fatty acids (VLCFA);** repeat after an overnight fast if the result is equivocal. A ketogenic diet can give a false positive.
claims.locator: Braverman NE, Raymond GV, Rizzo WB, Moser AB, Wilkinson ME, Stone EM, Steinberg SJ, Wangler MF, Rush ET, Hacia JG, Bose M; Molecular Genetics and Metabolism 117(3):313-321 (NIH author manuscript PMC5214431), 'Peroxisome biogenesis disorders in the Zellweger spectrum: An overview of current diagnosis, clinical manifestations, and treatment guidelines', published online 23 December 2015 (issue March 2016), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ymgme.2015.12.009, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Show that several peroxisomal pathways are abnormal:** phytanic and pristanic acids, red-cell plasmalogens, pipecolic acid and the bile acid intermediates DHCA and THCA. Do not rely on VLCFA alone, since some PEX variants leave it near normal.
claims.locator: Braverman NE, Raymond GV, Rizzo WB, Moser AB, Wilkinson ME, Stone EM, Steinberg SJ, Wangler MF, Rush ET, Hacia JG, Bose M; Molecular Genetics and Metabolism 117(3):313-321 (NIH author manuscript PMC5214431), 'Peroxisome biogenesis disorders in the Zellweger spectrum: An overview of current diagnosis, clinical manifestations, and treatment guidelines', published online 23 December 2015 (issue March 2016), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ymgme.2015.12.009, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **About 10-15% of suspected cases with raised VLCFA have a single-enzyme defect** (ACOX1 or D-bifunctional protein) instead; skin fibroblast studies help separate them.
claims.locator: Braverman NE, Raymond GV, Rizzo WB, Moser AB, Wilkinson ME, Stone EM, Steinberg SJ, Wangler MF, Rush ET, Hacia JG, Bose M; Molecular Genetics and Metabolism 117(3):313-321 (NIH author manuscript PMC5214431), 'Peroxisome biogenesis disorders in the Zellweger spectrum: An overview of current diagnosis, clinical manifestations, and treatment guidelines', published online 23 December 2015 (issue March 2016), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ymgme.2015.12.009, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Confirm with a PEX gene panel;** the genotype helps prognosis (two null alleles usually mean severe disease; PEX1 p.G843D usually milder) and identifies carriers for counselling.
claims.locator: Braverman NE, Raymond GV, Rizzo WB, Moser AB, Wilkinson ME, Stone EM, Steinberg SJ, Wangler MF, Rush ET, Hacia JG, Bose M; Molecular Genetics and Metabolism 117(3):313-321 (NIH author manuscript PMC5214431), 'Peroxisome biogenesis disorders in the Zellweger spectrum: An overview of current diagnosis, clinical manifestations, and treatment guidelines', published online 23 December 2015 (issue March 2016), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ymgme.2015.12.009, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Assess every organ system at diagnosis** and re-evaluate at least yearly to catch progression early.
claims.locator: Braverman NE, Raymond GV, Rizzo WB, Moser AB, Wilkinson ME, Stone EM, Steinberg SJ, Wangler MF, Rush ET, Hacia JG, Bose M; Molecular Genetics and Metabolism 117(3):313-321 (NIH author manuscript PMC5214431), 'Peroxisome biogenesis disorders in the Zellweger spectrum: An overview of current diagnosis, clinical manifestations, and treatment guidelines', published online 23 December 2015 (issue March 2016), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ymgme.2015.12.009, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **In severe PBD-ZSD, care centres on seizures, feeding and breathing:** any standard antiepileptic can be used (avoid respiratory depressants if breathing is compromised); a gastrostomy may be needed; discuss escalation of respiratory support openly with the family.
claims.locator: Braverman NE, Raymond GV, Rizzo WB, Moser AB, Wilkinson ME, Stone EM, Steinberg SJ, Wangler MF, Rush ET, Hacia JG, Bose M; Molecular Genetics and Metabolism 117(3):313-321 (NIH author manuscript PMC5214431), 'Peroxisome biogenesis disorders in the Zellweger spectrum: An overview of current diagnosis, clinical manifestations, and treatment guidelines', published online 23 December 2015 (issue March 2016), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ymgme.2015.12.009, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Feeding:** selective eating often needs a behavioural feeding programme; a gastrostomy may be needed for calories, and elemental formulas may be tolerated better because bile acid deficiency causes malabsorption.
claims.locator: Braverman NE, Raymond GV, Rizzo WB, Moser AB, Wilkinson ME, Stone EM, Steinberg SJ, Wangler MF, Rush ET, Hacia JG, Bose M; Molecular Genetics and Metabolism 117(3):313-321 (NIH author manuscript PMC5214431), 'Peroxisome biogenesis disorders in the Zellweger spectrum: An overview of current diagnosis, clinical manifestations, and treatment guidelines', published online 23 December 2015 (issue March 2016), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ymgme.2015.12.009, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **No specific diet is recommended.** Cutting dietary VLCFA has not been shown to help, and Lorenzo's oil may be harmful. Monitor plasma phytanic acid and restrict it in the diet only if levels become excessive.
claims.locator: Braverman NE, Raymond GV, Rizzo WB, Moser AB, Wilkinson ME, Stone EM, Steinberg SJ, Wangler MF, Rush ET, Hacia JG, Bose M; Molecular Genetics and Metabolism 117(3):313-321 (NIH author manuscript PMC5214431), 'Peroxisome biogenesis disorders in the Zellweger spectrum: An overview of current diagnosis, clinical manifestations, and treatment guidelines', published online 23 December 2015 (issue March 2016), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ymgme.2015.12.009, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **DHA supplements showed no clinical benefit in a placebo-controlled trial,** although DHA synthesis is impaired; give supplements of vitamins A, D, E and K instead, because bile acid synthesis is defective.
claims.locator: Braverman NE, Raymond GV, Rizzo WB, Moser AB, Wilkinson ME, Stone EM, Steinberg SJ, Wangler MF, Rush ET, Hacia JG, Bose M; Molecular Genetics and Metabolism 117(3):313-321 (NIH author manuscript PMC5214431), 'Peroxisome biogenesis disorders in the Zellweger spectrum: An overview of current diagnosis, clinical manifestations, and treatment guidelines', published online 23 December 2015 (issue March 2016), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ymgme.2015.12.009, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Liver:** give vitamin K 2.5-5 mg daily and monitor clotting and synthetic function; primary bile acid therapy (cholic acid) may reduce toxic intermediates, but evidence is limited. Refer overt liver dysfunction to gastroenterology.
claims.locator: Braverman NE, Raymond GV, Rizzo WB, Moser AB, Wilkinson ME, Stone EM, Steinberg SJ, Wangler MF, Rush ET, Hacia JG, Bose M; Molecular Genetics and Metabolism 117(3):313-321 (NIH author manuscript PMC5214431), 'Peroxisome biogenesis disorders in the Zellweger spectrum: An overview of current diagnosis, clinical manifestations, and treatment guidelines', published online 23 December 2015 (issue March 2016), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ymgme.2015.12.009, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Hearing:** test every year; fit hearing aids for significant loss, and consider cochlear implants when aids are not enough.
claims.locator: Braverman NE, Raymond GV, Rizzo WB, Moser AB, Wilkinson ME, Stone EM, Steinberg SJ, Wangler MF, Rush ET, Hacia JG, Bose M; Molecular Genetics and Metabolism 117(3):313-321 (NIH author manuscript PMC5214431), 'Peroxisome biogenesis disorders in the Zellweger spectrum: An overview of current diagnosis, clinical manifestations, and treatment guidelines', published online 23 December 2015 (issue March 2016), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ymgme.2015.12.009, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Vision:** regular eye reviews, early removal of any cataract, and glasses for refractive error; repeated ERGs add nothing, while OCT can track the retina. Link deaf-blind children with deaf-blind services.
claims.locator: Braverman NE, Raymond GV, Rizzo WB, Moser AB, Wilkinson ME, Stone EM, Steinberg SJ, Wangler MF, Rush ET, Hacia JG, Bose M; Molecular Genetics and Metabolism 117(3):313-321 (NIH author manuscript PMC5214431), 'Peroxisome biogenesis disorders in the Zellweger spectrum: An overview of current diagnosis, clinical manifestations, and treatment guidelines', published online 23 December 2015 (issue March 2016), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ymgme.2015.12.009, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Neurology:** EEG when seizures change; levetiracetam, phenobarbital, clonazepam, topiramate and lamotrigine are commonly used. Get a baseline brain MRI for leukodystrophy, and early physical, occupational and speech therapy for every child.
claims.locator: Braverman NE, Raymond GV, Rizzo WB, Moser AB, Wilkinson ME, Stone EM, Steinberg SJ, Wangler MF, Rush ET, Hacia JG, Bose M; Molecular Genetics and Metabolism 117(3):313-321 (NIH author manuscript PMC5214431), 'Peroxisome biogenesis disorders in the Zellweger spectrum: An overview of current diagnosis, clinical manifestations, and treatment guidelines', published online 23 December 2015 (issue March 2016), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ymgme.2015.12.009, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Bone and teeth:** DXA and vitamin D status if older than 1 year and non-weight-bearing or after fractures; bisphosphonates only with a metabolic bone specialist. Dental review every 6 months for enamel defects.
claims.locator: Braverman NE, Raymond GV, Rizzo WB, Moser AB, Wilkinson ME, Stone EM, Steinberg SJ, Wangler MF, Rush ET, Hacia JG, Bose M; Molecular Genetics and Metabolism 117(3):313-321 (NIH author manuscript PMC5214431), 'Peroxisome biogenesis disorders in the Zellweger spectrum: An overview of current diagnosis, clinical manifestations, and treatment guidelines', published online 23 December 2015 (issue March 2016), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ymgme.2015.12.009, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Adrenal:** from one year of age check ACTH and morning cortisol at least yearly; replace at standard doses if abnormal, and consider stress dosing in severe illness, fever or major surgery.
claims.locator: Braverman NE, Raymond GV, Rizzo WB, Moser AB, Wilkinson ME, Stone EM, Steinberg SJ, Wangler MF, Rush ET, Hacia JG, Bose M; Molecular Genetics and Metabolism 117(3):313-321 (NIH author manuscript PMC5214431), 'Peroxisome biogenesis disorders in the Zellweger spectrum: An overview of current diagnosis, clinical manifestations, and treatment guidelines', published online 23 December 2015 (issue March 2016), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ymgme.2015.12.009, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Kidney and vaccines:** screen older children (from about 4-6 years) for hyperoxaluria with urine oxalate and creatinine, and ultrasound for stones; give routine vaccines plus yearly influenza and RSV vaccination.
claims.locator: Braverman NE, Raymond GV, Rizzo WB, Moser AB, Wilkinson ME, Stone EM, Steinberg SJ, Wangler MF, Rush ET, Hacia JG, Bose M; Molecular Genetics and Metabolism 117(3):313-321 (NIH author manuscript PMC5214431), 'Peroxisome biogenesis disorders in the Zellweger spectrum: An overview of current diagnosis, clinical manifestations, and treatment guidelines', published online 23 December 2015 (issue March 2016), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ymgme.2015.12.009, retrieved 2026-09-23
